single.hardware: Apple M4, 10 CPU cores, 24 GiB RAM

scenario_notes.warm_cache: Foyer, 64 MiB, 4 shards. Read every block before each case.
scenario_notes.multiple_ssts: Eight L0 SSTs contain versions of the same keys. Compaction and GC are disabled.
scenario_notes.delay_control: InMemory store with a requested 1 ms timer delay per GET. Measured waits exceed 1 ms.
scenario_notes.external: The scan runs in Runtime::block_on on the caller thread.
scenario_notes.worker: The scan runs in one spawned Tokio task on a two-worker runtime.
scenario_notes.limits: Single caller, no external network, no binding overhead, no concurrent-client fairness measurement.

concurrency_and_s3.hardware: Apple M4, 10 CPU cores, 24 GiB RAM
concurrency_and_s3.probe: A separate OS thread submits a lightweight Tokio task every millisecond.
concurrency_and_s3.fairness: The Jain index uses completed queries per client within the shared time window.
concurrency_and_s3.s3_cache: Uncached cases disable SlateDB block caching. Metadata stays cached.
concurrency_and_s3.validation: Each scan asserts the key order, value bytes and row count.
concurrency_and_s3.host_load_note: macOS storage analysis used CPU time during the run. S3 samples varied.
